name: e-patti
description: E-Patti — Teen Patti score tracking and settlement calculation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @e-patti/shared && npm run build -w @e-patti/backend && npm run build -w @e-patti/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @e-patti/shared" "npm run dev -w @e-patti/backend" "npm run dev -w @e-patti/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @e-patti/shared && npm run test -w @e-patti/backend
